recipe.title: Mexican turkey stuffed sweet potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 200 C. Prick the sweet potatoes and bake them whole for 45 minutes.
Dice the turkey finely and cook it in a dry non-stick pan with cumin, paprika, garlic powder and salt for 8 minutes.
Drain the corn and mix it into the turkey.
Cut the baked sweet potatoes open and fill them with the turkey and corn.
Store in 4 containers. Slice the avocado fresh on the day you eat it, or cut it at prep and keep it with lemon juice.
